headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 23, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings. The Cleveland Guardians shut down the Philadelphia Phillies in a 1-0 win, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball and Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Mickey Moniak of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. Other players on the injured list include Jung Hoo Lee of the San Francisco Giants, Burch Smith of the Detroit Tigers, Ke'Bryan Hayes of the Cincinnati Reds, Yoán Moncada of the Los Angeles Angels, Yusei Kikuchi of the Los Angeles Angels, Matt Shaw of the Chicago Cubs, and Nathan Church of the St. Louis Cardinals.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for cash, the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, the Tampa Bay Rays trading LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays trading LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing a decisive victory. Kevin Gausman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland recorded the save.

top_news.title: **Yankees Edge Rays in Thrilling 0-0 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a narrow victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, winning the game 0-0. The outcome marked a close contest between the two teams.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Mickey Moniak on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. The injury occurred on May 22, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies made a trade on May 22, 2026, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for cash.
